title: Battle realtime engine in Go: bot battle, PvP, lobby chat broadcast, player stats

acceptance.text: challenge_bot starts a server-authoritative bot match: match_found, countdown, question (no correct key leaked), answer_result, score_update, finished; persisted in learning.battle_session/battle_round
battle:answer validates room owner, round index, option key and idempotency; 3 invalid attempts abandon the match

PvP: challenge_user/accept/decline with server-derived identity; both players get pvp_match_found, synchronized questions, per-player answer_result/score_update, finished with correct outcome; forfeit and disconnect grace end the match cleanly
POST /api/battle/chat broadcasts battle:lobby_message to lobby members and is rate limited (429); GET /api/battle/player-stats returns compact stats
Client-supplied userId is never trusted: identity always comes from the authenticated connection

red_exception.reason: Go battle engine (bot/PvP/commentary/store), player-stats endpoint, and Battle UI dark mode + runtime socket readiness
